mapper.select: SELECT pr.id, pr.persona_id AS personaId, pr.empresa, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.nombre, p.primer_apellido) AS nombre, p.telefono FROM proveedor pr JOIN persona p ON p.id = pr.persona_id WHERE pr.usuario_id = #{usuarioId} AND pr.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE
SELECT pe.proveedor_id FROM proveedor_especialidad pe JOIN proveedor pr ON pr.id = pe.proveedor_id AND pr.deleted = FALSE WHERE pe.servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND pe.deleted = FALSE

SELECT pr.id, pr.persona_id AS personaId, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.nombre, p.primer_apellido, p.segundo_apellido) AS personaNombre, p.telefono AS personaTelefono, p.email AS personaEmail, pr.empresa, pr.descripcion, pr.radio_cobertura_km AS radioCoberturaKm, pr.calificacion, pr.verificado FROM proveedor pr JOIN persona p ON p.id = pr.persona_id AND p.deleted = FALSE WHERE pr.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proveedor pr JOIN persona p ON p.id = pr.persona_id AND p.deleted = FALSE WHERE pr.deleted = FALSE

SELECT pe.servicio_id AS servicioId, s.nombre AS servicioNombre, pe.requiere_certificado AS requiereCertificado FROM proveedor_especialidad pe JOIN servicio s ON s.id = pe.servicio_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE pe.proveedor_id = #{proveedorId} AND pe.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY s.nombre
